about: One list of hook events for every host. The commands are the brain's own scripts; a host file only triggers them (SMART-RULE-0007). Regenerate .claude/settings.json with: hooks.py host-settings

events.held_back: the host session hooks cost tokens on every light session (before-and-after test, 28 September 2026); the pre-commit hook is proposed alone

events.note: fires only when a context is compacted, never on a light session, so the held-back reason of the session hooks does not apply; writes the compaction marker (trial of an amendment to SMART-RULE-0019)
the compacted thread reloads the contract and rules and writes the missed handover checkpoint before it dispatches anything (trial of an amendment to SMART-RULE-0019)
